title: Guided Evia walkthrough controls
details: Show me around keeps the real Evia home, course routes, task rows, evidence methods and progress arches from v221
Walkthrough guidance now appears inside one fixed speech bubble above the bottom controls
A yellow next-arrow inside the speech bubble moves the walkthrough to the next part
Each walkthrough change fades out and back in instead of switching abruptly
The round yellow Evia QR button is restored between Course and Learn and is demonstrated during assessor sharing
Photo, Video, Written and guided Audio evidence remain demonstrated
Course coverage, assessor QR exchange, Learn, Mock Practical, Maths Level 2 and English Level 2 remain demonstrated
The existing demo limits, QR activation, learner evidence, targets and Naxos course-pack behaviour are unchanged
summary: Evia v222 keeps the real-layout walkthrough but adds a fixed speech bubble, next-arrow navigation, fade transitions and the missing round yellow Evia QR button.
changes: Replaced the v221 walkthrough runtime with v222
Added fixed speech-bubble guidance and next-arrow control
Added fade transitions between walkthrough parts
Restored the yellow Evia QR button in the walkthrough home layout
Created a fresh v222 offline cache
